dataset: UCI HAPT 341, DOI 10.24432/C54G7M, CC BY 4.0. Public smartphone waist accelerometer and gyroscope samples at native 50 Hz, manually annotated by synchronized video. Acquire the original archive, preserve SHA256. Use RawData only. No artificial delay, masking of an observed free sensor, resampling, interpolation, permutation, or post-onset label as feature.
task: For each annotated stand->sit, sit->stand, sit->lie, lie->sit, stand->lie or lie->stand event, predict which of the other two postures is the destination. Starting posture and a manual onset trigger are given by the benchmark. Order these two destinations by numeric posture code sitting=0,standing=1,lying=2. This evaluates event-triggered decisions, not automatic onset detection. Never use the annotated end or event order as an input. After onset, real subsequent samples can lie after the transition ends. Require a full contiguous physical interval in the original recording; report any omissions without replacing them.
clock: Six decisions at true onset plus 0,.48,.96,1.44,1.92,2.40 seconds. Take the original one-based start row as onset. Present all free tri-axial acceleration samples through each decision, including a .48-second observed block ending at the trigger. Paid READ may access synchronized angular velocity and acceleration through the same decision, then terminates. Both instruments were physically recorded; .30 is a benchmark acquisition price, not a measured charge. Discount .20/s, wait cost .40/s, correct terminal payoff 1, incorrect 0. The .48-s decision clock matches 24 real samples exactly.
split: Use all eligible participant IDs 1..30. TEST=[3,6,9,12,15,18,21,24,27,30], DEV=[2,7,11,16,20,25], TRAIN=remaining 14. Split participants before reading sensor arrays. Repeat trials within participant are dependent. Source-mean evaluation. Fit/DEV can be opened before final seal. Publish or send parent externally recorded SHA of protocol before unsealing TRAIN/DEV; final fit/source SHA must be externally recorded before opening TEST. No conditional replacement or extra task based on outcomes.
classifiers: Per starting posture and clock, fit standardized subject-balanced centered ridge linear destination classifiers (lambda .10); clip linear probability to [.001,.999]. Free uses only native acceleration, paid uses same features plus native angular velocity. Per sensor use current block means/std/last-minus-first, last sample, current mean minus pre-onset block mean, difference of means of last and first thirds, RMS measured axis increments, cumulative mean and observed range since trigger block. Sensor coordinate channels are those published. Report free/paid source-macro accuracy at every prefix. Produce source-held-out TRAIN frontend predictions (leave one participant out); final classifiers use all TRAIN only.
primary: Simple WAIT/STOP (no READ) confidence policy; if max free probability >= c or at cap, STOP, otherwise WAIT. Clock caps [1,2,3] additional intervals, confidence [.55,.65,.75,.85,.95], plus immediate always STOP. DEV maximum source-mean discounted utility; ties prefer immediate, then earliest cap and smaller threshold in enumeration. Freeze before TEST. Primary success requires TEST source-macro gain >=.015 vs immediate free, positive in at least 2 held-out subjects, and conservative one-sided exact sign P<=.05 with ties counted as non-wins. Require observed WAIT. This criteria applies to the primary single policy.
controls: Choose strongest fixed noREAD exit prefix t=0..5 on DEV. Positive gain versus this baseline is separately required to attribute state-dependent timing; uniform gains from a fixed delay can establish useful information arrival but not the value of adaptive waiting. Enumerate all fixed paid/free exits, hindsight free WAIT benefit vs t0, joint WAIT vs best immediate per episode, and joint paid benefit vs best free-only future. Include counts and per-participant effects. Additional results descriptive, never substituted for primary.
models: Use same source-OOF classifier states and existing causal nuisance function qualification.hcsn_intervention_value.policy.fit_teacher separately for full and noREAD action laws. Compare plain conditional ridge, original fixed and internal analytic-QVI #6958/#6739 readouts (3 seeds 181391,284729,395201) on identical causal state. Direct 0.001 ridge SVD, fixed nonlinear encoders, no tuning of physical weights. Features include current free classifier probability, margin, free sensor descriptor and known start posture, plus causally accumulated state. Each learned policy compared to its DEV-locked strongest immediate among free/paid/own zero-delay STOP-or-READ, matched dynamic noREAD, read-disable and fixed-exit controls. Report mean utility, accuracy, reads/waits, TEST comparisons by participant. No claim about end-to-end encoder training, biomedical diagnosis or energy.
mechanism: Describe conditional WAIT by fixed initial confidence strata [.5,.6),[.6,.75),[.75,.9),[.9,1], including later actual free accuracy and excess utility. Report whether only a generic fixed delay suffices, and disclose task onset supplied, common scripted action protocol, trace statistics and physical sensor charging. Publication includes class/feature code, participant roster, original SHA, sealed decisions and per-episode results. Only one semantic workload, no outcome-driven task changes.
